description: Source code for the EmojiStore implementation in the Mattermost server, handling emoji database operations such as save, get, delete, and search.

classes.name: SqlEmojiStore
classes.description: Implementation of the EmojiStore interface, providing methods to interact with emoji data in the database.

methods.name: newSqlEmojiStore
methods.description: Constructor for SqlEmojiStore, initializes query builder and store with database connection and metrics.

methods.name: Save
methods.description: Saves an emoji to the database after validation.

methods.name: GetMultipleByName
methods.description: Retrieves multiple emojis by a list of names.

methods.name: GetList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of emojis with pagination and sorting.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Marks an emoji as deleted in the database.

methods.name: Search
methods.description: Searches for emojis by name with optional prefix matching.

methods.name: getBy
methods.description: Helper method to retrieve a single emoji by a specified column and value.
